title: Automating Combined Higher-Round Differential MITM Attacks
summary: Differential MITM attacks can use techniques unavailable to classical differential attacks, but automating a combined approach over more rounds remains open.

formal_statement.body: Build a tool combining differential MITM, parallel partitioning, and bicliques for higher-round attacks.

scope.domain: Automated symmetric-key cryptanalysis combining differential meet-in-the-middle, parallel-partitioning, and biclique techniques.
parameters: Attack-round coverage — the tool targets higher-round attacks
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a tool that integrates differential MITM, parallel partitioning, and bicliques for attacks over more rounds.

progress.summary: The conclusion explicitly presents this as an open problem after arguing that differential MITM can use techniques unavailable to classical differential attacks. It leaves automation of the combined higher-round strategy unresolved.
citation_labels: Zahra Ahmadian et al., Improved Differential Meet-In-The-Middle Cryptanalysis
